title: Pseudo-coherence is preserved by derived pullback

core_obligations: Represent E by E^*, choose the covering V_i and presentations alpha_i; by the independent-representative lemma it suffices to show Lf^*E^*|_{U_i} is m-pseudo-coherent; form the triangle E_i^* -> E^*|_{V_i} -> C with H^j(C) = 0 for j >= m (proof lines 12022-12034).

Apply Lf_i^*: H^j(Lf_i^*C) = 0 for j >= m by the construction of Lf_i^* as a left derived functor (dual of Derived Categories, Lemma negative-vanishing), so H^j(Lf_i^*alpha_i) are isomorphisms for j > m and surjective for j = m (proof lines 12035-12047).
Lf_i^*E_i^* = f_i^*E_i^* is strictly perfect by the strictly-perfect-pullback lemma; conclude (proof lines 12048-12057).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the pullbacks of the presentations.
Control the cone after pullback via the derived functor construction.
Conclude with strict perfection of the pullback.
difficulty_reason: Localize, form the cone C of the presentation (cohomology vanishing in degrees >= m), pull back the triangle, control the vanishing of H^j(Lf_i^*C) through the construction of the left derived pullback, and conclude with the strict perfection of the pullback of a strictly perfect complex.
